# Repeat <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
Repeat
statements
Until condition
Repeat
statements
Forever
```

## Description

Runs the statements, then ends with [Until](Until) when its condition is true, or with [Forever](Forever) never on its own. Because the condition is tested last, the statements run at least once.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
n = 10
Repeat
	Print n
	n = n + 1
Until n > 3
```

```text
10
```
